Learning Beyond the Classroom 

SVKM's Pravin Gandhi College of Law was delighted to welcome Ms. Tanisha C. PGCL alumna, back to campus for a specialised session on Arbitration.

Drawing from her professional experience, Tanisha shared practical insights into the evolving landscape of arbitration, helping students connect doctrinal concepts with real-world dispute resolution. The interactive session encouraged meaningful discussions and provided students with valuable perspectives on careers and practice in arbitration.

At PGCL, such alumni interactions strengthen peer learning, inspire aspiring legal professionals, and reinforce the enduring bond between our alumni and the institution.

We thank Tanisha for returning to her alma mater and contributing to the academic journey of our students.
PGCL Alumni Association
